The organisation, in a statement signed by its Convener, […]

Kungiyar neman tsaro da tattalin arzikin gida (SERN), wata alaƙar jama'a, ta bukaci jama'ar kasuwancin man fetur a Niger Delta su goyi bayan sojojin Nigeria a cikin yakinsu a kan cin sata mai, sata mai ba bisa ka'ida da jikin lallai a yankin. articles.title: ‘Go your way’, Fubara tells supporters unwilling to join Wike’s Rainbow Coalition
articles.summary:
Governor Fubara has warned supporters opposed to his alignment with Mr Wike’s Rainbow Coalition to leave, as the former political rivals mobilise support for President Tinubu’s 2027 re-election bid in Rivers State.
The post ‘Go your way’, Fubara tells supporters unwilling to join Wike’s Rainbow Coalition appeared first on Premium Times Nigeria.
articles.hausa_translation: Sarki Fubara ya gargada magatarunsa waɗanda ba su so haɗin gwiwa da Rainbow Coalition na Wike, su tafi jiya, yayin da tsohon abokan gida suka fara tara goida don sake zaɓin Shugaban Kasar Tinubu a 2027 a Rivers State.
critical_questions: What specific policies or principles are motivating Fubara's supporters to resist alignment with Wike, and why does Fubara frame dissent as requiring departure rather than dialogue?
Given Fubara and Wike's well-documented political rivalry, what incentives or pressure (financial, political, or otherwise) underpin this sudden coalition, and who benefits most from their union?
How many supporters are actually 'unwilling' to join, and is this statement preemptive messaging to suppress internal party dissent before it gains momentum?
Why is the 2027 presidential re-election campaign a priority focus in Rivers State now, and what immediate political or electoral developments triggered this public ultimatum?
Who are the 'missing voices'—grassroots party members or opposition figures—that might offer counter-perspectives on this coalition's legitimacy or terms?

articles.title: Lagos townhall: Obi, NDC supporters reject new national anthem after violence
articles.summary: “Arise O Compatriots”, was chosen over “Nigeria, We Hail Thee!” at the opening of the townhall meeting of  Peter Obi, Presidential Candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), in Lagos, on Thursday. The event billed to start in the morning didn’t commence until 6pm as a result of invasion by political thugs. Preparations were ongoing […]
articles.hausa_translation: Jerin gida a Lagos: Obi, masu goyon NDC sun ƙi sabuwar sautin kasa bayan tashin hankali
critical_questions: Why did political thugs specifically target this NDC townhall, and which political actors benefit from preventing Obi's campaign activities?

What evidence exists that supporters 'rejected' the new anthem versus the anthem being used as a pretext for violence?

articles.title: 2027: Court orders INEC to publish Adebutu’s name
articles.summary: A Federal High Court in Abuja, on Friday, ruled that the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) had no power to unilaterally disqualify a candidate from contesting an election and ordered the reinstatement of the name of the governorship candidate of the Peoples Democratic Party in Ogun State, Ladi Adebutu, on the Commission’s candidates’ list within […]
articles.hausa_translation: Kasuwa: Kotun ta ba da umarnin ga INEC na buga sunan Adebutu a jerin 'yan takara. Kotun ta yanke hukunci cewa INEC ba ta da ikon yin watsi da 'yan takara ba kuma ta umarci maimakon suna na Ladi Adebutu, wanda ya nemi zabe a matsayin gwamna na Ogun State don PDP.
critical_questions: What were the specific grounds INEC cited for Adebutu's initial disqualification, and does the court ruling suggest those grounds were procedurally flawed or substantively invalid?
Who appealed this case and what is the timeline - was this ruling made before or after the 2027 election campaign period, affecting the actual candidacy outcome?

Police spokesperson in Rivers State, ASP Agabe Blessing Kaborlo, confirmed the arrest in a statement on Friday […]
